summary: sol-wallet-adapter preinstall beacons installer hostname and username to hardcoded Discord webhook
details: On every `npm install`, the package's `preinstall` lifecycle script (preinstall.js) reads `os.hostname()` and `os.userInfo().username` and POSTs them, with a timestamp, to a hardcoded Discord webhook at https://canary.discord.com/api/webhooks/1566232728179843243/.... The exfiltration fires automatically before any user action and is directed to an attacker-controlled channel. The published name `sol-wallet-adapter` resembles the Solana wallet-adapter ecosystem, but the package internally identifies as `cutekitten-test` and ships only a trivial stub index.js; the install-time beacon is the sole functional code.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
